metadata.question: Did the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India, decrease between 2018 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Sambhar, India (approximately 26.9°N, 75.1°E) - a large salt lake in Rajasthan - Time: Compare 2018 vs 2019 (use full year or dry season for consistency) - Collection: Use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR (cloud-free) or optical data with water indices 2. Masking strategy: - For optical data (Sentinel-2/Landsat): Need cloud masking, then calculate water indices (MNDWI, NDWI) - For SAR (Sentinel-1): No cloud masking needed, water shows as dark/low backscatter - JRC dataset already has water classification I'll use Sentinel-2 with MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) as primary, with fallback options. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Lake genuinely has 0 or reduced water (answer B for decrease, A for no decrease) - C1: No images found for either year - C2: All pixels masked out (unlikely for a large lake) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values Strategy: Calculate water area in km² for both years, compare. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions lake_sambhar = ee.Geometry.Point([75.1, 26.9]).buffer(15000) # ~15km radius to cover the lake date_2018_start = '2018-01-01' date_2018_end = '2018-12-31' date_2019_start = '2019-01-01' date_2019_end = '2019-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 def mask_s2_clouds(image): qa = image.select('QA60') cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)) return image.updateMask(cloud_mask) def add_mndwi(image): mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI') return image.addBands(mndwi) col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterBounds(lake_sambhar) \ .filterDate(date_2018_start, date_2018_end) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \ .map(mask_s2_clouds) \ .map(add_mndwi) col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterBounds(lake_sambhar) \ .filterDate(date_2019_start, date_2019_end) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \ .map(mask_s2_clouds) \ .map(add_mndwi) size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo() size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo() print(f"2018 Images: {size_2018}") print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}") if size_2018 == 0 or size_2019 == 0: print("Insufficient imagery for comparison.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Create median composites and extract water composite_2018 = col_2018.median() composite_2019 = col_2019.median() # Water threshold: MNDWI > 0 indicates water water_2018 = composite_2018.select('MNDWI').gt(0) water_2019 = composite_2019.select('MNDWI').gt(0) # 4. Calculate water area pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea() area_2018_result = water_2018.multiply(pixel_area).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake_sambhar, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ) area_2019_result = water_2019.multiply(pixel_area).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake_sambhar, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ) # Count valid pixels count_2018 = water_2018.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lake_sambhar, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('MNDWI').getInfo() count_2019 = water_2019.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lake_sambhar, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('MNDWI').getInfo() area_2018_m2 = area_2018_result.get('MNDWI').getInfo() area_2019_m2 = area_2019_result.get('MNDWI').getInfo() print(f"2018 Valid Pixels: {count_2018}") print(f"2019 Valid Pixels: {count_2019}") if count_2018 == 0 or count_2019 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif area_2018_m2 is None or area_2019_m2 is None: print("Calculation failed to return valid values.") print("C3") else: area_2018_km2 = area_2018_m2 / 1e6 area_2019_km2 = area_2019_m2 / 1e6 print(f"2018 Water Area: {area_2018_km2:.2f} km²") print(f"2019 Water Area: {area_2019_km2:.2f} km²") print(f"Change: {area_2019_km2 - area_2018_km2:.2f} km²") # Check if water extent decreased if area_2019_km2 < area_2018_km2: print("Water extent decreased from 2018 to 2019.") print("A") else: print("Water extent did not decrease from 2018 to 2019.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
lake_sambhar = ee.Geometry.Point([75.1, 26.9]).buffer(15000)  # ~15km radius to cover the lake

date_2018_start = '2018-01-01'
date_2018_end = '2018-12-31'
date_2019_start = '2019-01-01'
date_2019_end = '2019-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask)

def add_mndwi(image):
    mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI')
    return image.addBands(mndwi)

col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(lake_sambhar) \
    .filterDate(date_2018_start, date_2018_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds) \
    .map(add_mndwi)

col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(lake_sambhar) \
    .filterDate(date_2019_start, date_2019_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds) \
    .map(add_mndwi)

size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo()
size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo()

print(f"2018 Images: {size_2018}")
print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}")

if size_2018 == 0 or size_2019 == 0:
    print("Insufficient imagery for comparison.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Create median composites and extract water
    composite_2018 = col_2018.median()
    composite_2019 = col_2019.median()
    
    # Water threshold: MNDWI > 0 indicates water
    water_2018 = composite_2018.select('MNDWI').gt(0)
    water_2019 = composite_2019.select('MNDWI').gt(0)
    
    # 4. Calculate water area
    pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea()
    
    area_2018_result = water_2018.multiply(pixel_area).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=lake_sambhar,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    area_2019_result = water_2019.multiply(pixel_area).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=lake_sambhar,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    # Count valid pixels
    count_2018 = water_2018.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=lake_sambhar,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('MNDWI').getInfo()
    
    count_2019 = water_2019.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=lake_sambhar,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('MNDWI').getInfo()
    
    area_2018_m2 = area_2018_result.get('MNDWI').getInfo()
    area_2019_m2 = area_2019_result.get('MNDWI').getInfo()
    
    print(f"2018 Valid Pixels: {count_2018}")
    print(f"2019 Valid Pixels: {count_2019}")
    
    if count_2018 == 0 or count_2019 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif area_2018_m2 is None or area_2019_m2 is None:
        print("Calculation failed to return valid values.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        area_2018_km2 = area_2018_m2 / 1e6
        area_2019_km2 = area_2019_m2 / 1e6
        
        print(f"2018 Water Area: {area_2018_km2:.2f} km²")
        print(f"2019 Water Area: {area_2019_km2:.2f} km²")
        print(f"Change: {area_2019_km2 - area_2018_km2:.2f} km²")
        
        # Check if water extent decreased
        if area_2019_km2 < area_2018_km2:
            print("Water extent decreased from 2018 to 2019.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Water extent did not decrease from 2018 to 2019.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
